desc: The most versatile Lead Sled in the Caldwell Lead Sled Family, the Max offers maximum recoil reduction, versatility, and accuracy. Its modular design transforms into three rests in seconds. A removable weight reservoir can hold water, sand, gravel, or other materials to absorb recoil from magnum rifles and shotguns. The sliding frame is length-adjustable and folds for compact storage and easy transport. The front rest features a clamping head that securely holds the firearm and an enlarged elevation wheel with positive detent adjustment. It also has backlash-free fine windage and elevation adjustments at the rear. Maximize your shooting with the Lead Sled Max and eliminate the variables that cause you to miss.
